name: Decorate Object
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one object (up to 1 lb./level)
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (item); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You can add detail to a crafted item, or alter existing details. Note that this does not change the composition, size, or capabilities of any item — you can etch runes into a blade, for example, but the symbols are purely decorative and do not enchant the weapon or even change its quality (such as making an item masterwork or removing masterwork quality).
